SRC-324:R001.text: Authenticates and delivers a valid native operator event with a verified worker and correct continuation result, or

SRC-324:R002.text: Returns a precise actionable failure without falsely claiming operator authority. A recoverable infrastructure defect is repaired automatically when this can be done without inventing human authority. No unsealed event renews a bounded goal. No legitimate event is silently dropped during recoverable retry. Real installed-host acceptance is mandatory before declaring this incident completely solved.
